title: Ὀνομαστικόν / Onomasticon / «Ономастикон»; unit: Book 8 (law courts, laws, magistracies)
author: Julius Pollux (Ioulios Polydeukes) of Naucratis
genre: Thematic onomastic lexicon / thesaurus of realia
size: 10 books (epitomized). Bethe's edition is about 550 Teubner pp. Estimate: more than 100k Greek words.
edition: E. Bethe, Lexicographi Graeci IX (Teubner 1900–37; Bethe died 1940, so public domain in most jurisdictions). Bekker 1846 (PD). Both scanned on archive.org.
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Юлий Поллукс) lists no translation. Only tiny excerpts: Onom. 3.149–155 (Yanzina & Korneev, Индоевроп. языкознание и класс. филология 26, 2022, doi 10.30842/ielcp230690152678) and 9.83 in ФРГФ (1989).
en_evidence: Jean Golding Institute, Bristol (Aug 2024): 'not translated into any modern language'. Naomi Scott's crowdsourcing project is only at prototype stage. Only extracts on theatre and masks exist (1775; modern Book 4 excerpts).
other_translations: No complete translation in any modern language. Only articles on single passages (e.g. Polish, 2021, Book 4 medical terms). Latin 1502.
value: Unique thesaurus of Greek life: cult, theatre, music, law, money, crafts, the body, games. Quotes lost comedy and Attic prose. Cited constantly by historians of Athenian institutions, theatre and daily life, yet never translated. Absolute flagship for Neoscholia.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: list-like Attic vocabulary suits LLMs. Synonym clusters, the epitomized and corrupt text and identifying quotations need expert review, which suits multi-model cross-critique.
pilot_unit: Book 8 (Athenian courts, laws, archons, the constitution). Estimate 10–12k Greek words. Alternatives: Book 9 (city, coins, games) or Book 4 (music, theatre).
